# Owned synthetic cutout corpus

Every file under `corpus/` is deterministically generated by
`tools/generate_corpus.py`, Copyright 2026 itsmygithubacct, and distributed
under this repository's Apache-2.0 licence. There are no external photographs,
model generations, private images, or inherited dataset terms.

The corpus is a safety/contract fixture, not evidence that a release model
meets a quality floor. Its 100-megapixel case is excluded from the default unit
suite and is used only by explicitly bounded large-image probes.
